source_note: Original AI-assisted community practice path spanning entry, mid, and senior individual-contributor tasks. Each pinned round is a separate practice attempt, not a hiring sequence. Practitioner review and scoring calibration are pending; these exercises do not certify professional or operational competence.
name: Manufacturing Practice
blurb: Practice lot traceability, serial-line capacity, and supplier pilot evaluation.

rounds.title: Manufacturing Quality Trainee: Protect Lot Traceability
rounds.focus: Hold an uncertain lot identity and preserve evidence instead of turning a plausible guess into a dispatch record.

rounds.title: Manufacturing Engineer: Find the Constraint in a Capacity Proposal
rounds.focus: Use serial-stage capacity to challenge a throughput claim and propose a measured improvement.

rounds.title: Senior Manufacturing Engineer: Review a Supplier Pilot Release
rounds.focus: Separate final acceptance from hidden rework and test a supplier claim under comparable production conditions.
